Generated Narrative: CodeSystem em-dispatch-priority

This case-sensitive code system https://nshr-uat.sha.go.ke/fhir/CodeSystem/em-dispatch-priority defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
P1 Priority 1 – ImmediateImmediately life-threatening incident requiring the highest response priority.
P2 Priority 2 – UrgentPotentially serious incident requiring an urgent response.
P3 Priority 3 – Non-urgentStable or non-life-threatening incident.
P4 Priority 4 – Advice or scheduled responseIncident suitable for advice, referral, or a scheduled response.
unknown UnknownDispatch priority has not been determined.
